thread:
jess-cs: pinging the channel — Acme reported a regression after last night's rollout. Their snippets are getting duplicated backticks and extra trailing tokens in code blocks. customer says their app shows broken rendered markdown. attaching minimal repro they sent.

lia-acme: reproduction from our side (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-code-3b","prompt":"Write a short python function:\n\n```python\ndef add(a,b):\n    return a+b\n```","stop":["```"],"max_tokens":60}'
```

lia-acme: Response body ends with an extra ``` and then a stray "END_SNIPPET" token on multiple requests. Not intermittent, reproducible for us ~8/10.

jess-cs: customer says it started right after the 02:00 UTC rollout (deploy-bot reported a prod rollout at 2026-03-10T02:05:12Z). They prefer a quick rollback if this is a risky change.

deploy-bot: [deploy] service=runtime canary->prod rollout finished: id=deploy-20260310-0205 by @ci-pipeline (2026-03-10T02:05:12Z)

sam-eng-ml: thanks, collecting details. which model variant did they hit (quantized/fp16)? does their prompt always include fenced code as a single token sequence?

lia-acme: model name in response metadata: "redwood-code-3b-8bit". Prompt always includes fenced block as shown. We also tried explicit stop=["```","END_SNIPPET"] and still get extra backticks before the stop.

mohit-eng-runtime: possible suspect: the tokenizer normalization in the quantized variant had a change to merge certain backtick sequences, and the post-tokenizer de-dup step might be misfiring under batched prefix caching. Can you attach the raw resp (headers + body) and the request id?

lia-acme: request ids: r-0a1b2c3d4e (2026-03-10T02:12:07Z) and r-0a1b2c3d5f (2026-03-10T02:15:22Z). Full body snippet: 
```
{"id":"r-0a1b2c3d4e","model":"redwood-code-3b-8bit","output":"```python\ndef add(a,b):\n    return a+b\n```\n```END_SNIPPET\n","tokens":["```","python","\ndef"," add","(","a",",","b",")",":","\n    return a+b","\n","```","END_SNIPPET"]}
```

sam-eng-ml: that token array is interesting — the tokenizer emitted both ``` and END_SNIPPET tokens, but the join produced an extra fence. Looks like stop-seq pruning happened after token join. We should reproduce locally with the same quantized kernel and prefix cache settings.

anya-oncall: I'm going to spin a repro using their request ids on the staging replica with the same model variant. If it's deterministic we can confirm quickly. @mohit-eng-runtime can you check recent changes to the post-processing/stop handling around the deployment window?

mohit-eng-runtime: checking commits — there was a micro-optimization in token post-processing that moved stop-seq trimming to after detokenize to avoid repeated detokenize calls during batching (PR #4521). That could cause duplicated delimiter fragments when a stop token spans a boundary between cached prefix and new tokens. Rolling back that change in prod should restore previous semantics.

alex-product: we need to balance rollback risk vs impact. Customer page rendering broken for production traffic is high severity. Recommend emergency rollback of the change for the quantized variant and schedule a test matrix for prefix-boundary stop tokens.

anya-oncall: agreed. initiating rollback for quantized kernel change now. will monitor error rates and customer repro.

deploy-bot: [rollback] service=runtime rollback applied: id=rb-20260310-0310 by @anya-oncall (2026-03-10T03:10:03Z).

anya-oncall: rollback completed. lia, can you re-run your curl test?

lia-acme: re-tested r-0a1b2c3d4e and r-0a1b2c3d5f equivalents — now the response ends cleanly with a single ``` and no END_SNIPPET appended. Rendering is fixed on our side. :relieved:

jess-cs: customer confirmed they consider this resolved for now and asked for a postmortem and mitigation plan so they can avoid similar breakage in the future.

sam-eng-ml: filing a follow-up: reproduce matrix for stop tokens across (quantized/fp16, with/without prefix cache, batching sizes) + unit tests to ensure stop trimming happens before detokenize. I'll add regression cases based on lia's token arrays.

mohit-eng-runtime: also adding a quick integration test that runs common fenced code prompts through the affected kernel variants and asserts no duplicate fence tokens.

alex-product: thanks everyone. jess, please send the customer the rollback confirmation and an ETA for the postmortem.

jess-cs: will do — sharing rollback confirmation and ETA (postmortem by 2026-03-12 EOD). moving thread to resolved unless more repros appear. :white_check_mark:
